chunks: And when the caravan departed, he said, 'I smell the scent of Joseph, if you were not to find fault with me.'

key_terms.تُفَنِّدُونِ: you find fault with me / dismiss my words

ai.seo_question: What did Jacob say when the caravan departed regarding Joseph?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (Ya'qub) demonstrates the Shia concept of *'alam al-ghayb* (knowledge of the unseen) through sensory perception, specifically smelling the fragrance of Yusuf as the caravan departed Egypt. He warns his family not to dismiss his spiritual insight as mere senility (*tufanniduni*), highlighting the tension between physical evidence and divine intuition. This moment underscores the continuity of prophetic intuition across generations, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the infallible Imams' awareness of hidden realities.
